predicates.PRIMARY: at BOTH of MTTOP and BOTHTOP, vs the ABSENT control: CI_upper(bodyLatGap) < 0 AND CI_upper(compressionShortfall) < 0 AND the detachMean CI does NOT resolve POSITIVE
predicates.SAG-FIRED: weak-side-back in-trigger sag census: saggedGtBase > 0 AND tightened = 0 AND meanSagOnSlackPositive ≥ 1.4 m (the traced markingAggression stance band)
predicates.F-MT-a: SAG-FIRED at BOTH MTTOP and BOTHTOP AND the bodyLatGap CI INCLUDES ZERO at BOTH ⇒ STOP: the stance geometry is the wrong delivery; the fork returns to the user WITH the trace
predicates.F-MT-b: (at least one BODY-MOVING arm, CI_upper(bodyLatGap) < 0) AND (at EVERY such arm the equilibrium BAND fails on a GATED dimension — dimensions the CONTROL itself fails are DISCLOSED and EXCLUDED) ⇒ STOP: marking's defensive function breaks
predicates.F-MT-c: (at least one BODY-MOVING arm) AND (at EVERY such arm GUARD-NI fails) ⇒ STOP: the clump re-imports. GUARD-NI(a) = spreadY_out and spacingMedian CI_lower > −tol AND spacingUnder4 and dupRun CI_upper < +tol, tol = 0.2763 × |control level|
predicates.FLAG: offsides — resolvedly UP at any armed arm returns the axis to the USER; it NEVER flips PASS/FAIL (the #157 instrument debt, the F-S2d form)
predicates.REPORTED: the swallow share · mark-assignment drift (markShare / far-side share / distToMark / markLatGap — the map §2.4 EMERGENT feedback channel named by #202.2) · the ask instruments · the detach/steer receipts · the sag census. NONE of these gates anything.

honesty: FROZEN BEFORE SIGHT: the arms, seeds, N rule, gates, predicates and tolerances were written in the stage doc before any full-N number existed, and are not re-cut afterwards.
THE SMOKE ADJUDICATES NOTHING and may not tune any threshold: it proves plumbing and publishes exactly two sizing numbers (ms/match, min paired-BODY yield) which feed ONLY N.

THE ARMS DIFFER IN EXACTLY WHAT THE TABLE SAYS: two MatchConfig flags and two gene values. Nothing else moves; src/** is untouched (X-SRC-ZERO) and the doses travel the real gene channel on all three genome views of both teams (#196.3-D6).
The arms diverge tick-for-tick, so PAIRING IS ON THE SEED, not on the episode: each seed contributes one paired delta per arm, and the bootstrap clusters on the seed.
MT-T1 ships nothing (Road B): both flags stay absent from every bundle and play-test world, both genes stay born-absent, and the production fingerprint is re-derived unchanged.
THIS EXAM MAKES NO OSCILLATION CLAIM (switchKey is retracted, #188 §8.4) and decides nothing about whether the compression is GOOD FOOTBALL — SPREAD_R = 9 m is a RULER, not a target.
